algorithms.label: A1) Refined Cost + Greedy 1:1
algorithms.description: Refined cost evaluated per EV-slot pair, followed by greedy unique 1:1 assignment.

algorithms.label: A1 Ablation) DTW Off
algorithms.description: A1 refined-cost variant with DTW term disabled (step-signature + mean-gap).

algorithms.label: A1 Ablation) Step Signature Off
algorithms.description: A1 refined-cost variant with step-signature term disabled (DTW-only + mean-gap).

algorithms.label: A1 Ablation) All Waveform Terms Off
algorithms.description: A1 variant with waveform terms removed; falls back to timing-only assignment.

algorithms.label: A2) Corr+DTW + Hungarian
algorithms.description: Nomura original correlation + DTW scoring with dense global Hungarian as reference baseline.

algorithms.label: A2 Ablation) DTW Off (Corr-only)
algorithms.description: A2 variant using only correlation term (DTW contribution removed).

algorithms.label: A2 Ablation) Corr Off (DTW-only)
algorithms.description: A2 variant using only DTW term (correlation contribution removed).

algorithms.label: A2 Ablation) All Waveform Terms Off
algorithms.description: A2 variant with waveform terms removed; falls back to timing-only assignment.

algorithms.label: A3) Bayesian Posterior + Hungarian + Lock
algorithms.description: Time prior + current likelihood + posterior accumulation, posterior-Hungarian assignment, and confidence lock.

algorithms.label: A3 Ablation) Lock Off
algorithms.description: A3 variant with confidence-lock behavior disabled.

algorithms.label: A3 Ablation) Posterior Memory Off
algorithms.description: A3 variant with posterior memory term removed (prev-power=0).

algorithms.label: A3 Ablation) Time Prior Off
algorithms.description: A3 variant with timing-prior influence removed.

algorithms.label: A3 Ablation) Time Prior + Memory + Lock Off
algorithms.description: A3 variant removing time-prior, posterior-memory, and lock behavior (current-likelihood only).

online_operational_conditions.assignment_policy: window-fixed (arrival+window) global 1:1 on matured windows, finalization at window watermark

sources.title: IETF RFC 6455 (WebSocket Protocol)
sources.evidence: WebSocket protocol is layered over TCP, so transport delivery is reliable and ordered.

sources.title: IETF RFC 6298 (TCP RTO)
sources.evidence: Initial retransmission timeout lower bound is 1 second; Internet RTT is typically below 1 second.

sources.title: FCC Measuring Broadband America, 13th Report
sources.evidence: Reported latency spans tens of milliseconds, while packet-loss quality thresholds are around sub-1%.

sources.title: Zaptec OCPP Key-Value Settings
sources.evidence: Operational keys include MessageTimeout=10s and retry controls, supporting a practical 10s ingest cap.

sources.title: ABB Terra AC OCPP Configuration Guide
sources.evidence: Meter value sampling interval is configurable and commonly set to 30s in OCPP deployments.

notes: This baseline is evidence-informed and intended for realistic online-operation emulation.
It is not field-calibrated to one specific site; site logs should be used for final calibration.
EVSE physical current dynamics (15s first-step, 5s subsequent-step, ramp/offset model) remain unchanged.

pattern_generation_methods.current: Optimized generator (maximin/proxy-distance based) used in current research code.
pattern_generation_methods.legacy: Legacy random unique method: [0 + (steps-1) unique values sampled from 6..30].
pattern_generation_methods.legacy_interval: Correlation-DTW_EV_interval style legacy generator, then fixed sequential assignment to EVSE slots.

note: Algorithm comparison in dynamic parking environment. Important: all selected algorithms run under the same online operational constraints (EV cloud ingestion delay/loss and window-watermark decision flow). For each scenario/repeat, one dataset and one ingestion realization are generated and replayed to every algorithm. Decision windows are anchored to EV observed-start estimates (non-oracle, jittered), not direct ground-truth plug-in timestamps. Differences are limited to each algorithm's assignment/cost strategy. EV cloud ingestion defaults follow an evidence-informed baseline (not site-calibrated). EVSE side is treated as console-known reference (no EVSE uplink delay/loss model).
